items.d: 인공지능(AI)이 막대한 데이터를 요구하면서 세계 전역에서 ‘하이퍼스케일러(대규모 데이터센터)’가 우후죽순으로 들어서고 있다. 한국도 2027년부터 대규모 데이터센터가 들어설 예정인 가운데, 한발 앞서 하이퍼스케일러가 들어선 미국에서는 데이터센터가 야기한 수자원과 전력, 열섬 등의 문제로 인해 기업과 주민 간 마찰이 빚어지고 있다. 미국 애리조나주 피닉스 현지 취재 결과 데이터센터가 유발한 열기는 한낮의 태양을 능가했다. 한국에서는 어떤 상황이 일어날지 시뮬레이션해 본 결과 울산에 데이터센터를 지을 경우 최대 4도 더워질 것으로 예측됐다. 국내외를 막론하고 전문가들은 향후 들어설 데이터센터의 입지에 신중을 기해야 한다고 강조했다.● ‘코앞’ 닥친 데이터센터, 열기는 한낮 태양 넘었다 9월 17일 방문한 미국

items.t: SoftBank’s Son Plans $50 Billion Malaysia Tech Outlay, PM Says
items.d: Masayoshi Son of SoftBank Group Corp. chose locations in Malaysia for $50 billion in technology investments, the country’s prime minister said, an outlay that would accelerate the billionaire’s global bet on AI infrastructure.
items.fullText: Technology Asia SoftBank’s Son Plans $50 Billion Malaysia Tech Outlay, PM Says Facebook X LinkedIn Email Link Gift Expand Masayoshi Son Photographer: Fred Mery/Bloomberg Facebook X LinkedIn Email Link Gift Gift this article Contact us: Provide news feedback or report an error Confidential tip? Send a tip to our reporters Site feedback: Take our Survey New Window Facebook X LinkedIn Email Link Gift By Anuradha Raghu October 25, 2026 at 7:42 AM UTC Bookmark Save Takeaways by Bloomberg AI Masayoshi Son of SoftBank Group Corp. chose locations in Malaysia for $50 billion in technology investments, the country’s prime minister said, an outlay that would accelerate the billionaire’s global bet on AI infrastructure. Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said he had a videoconference with Son on Tuesday, during which the Japanese tech investor said he had picked regions in the Southeast Asian country for projects including data centers. SoftBank representatives didn’t immediately respond to a request for comment outside normal business hours.

items.fullText: 테크 한경 PREMIUM9 AI를 넘어서는 성공투자 구독하기 AI 추천 뉴스 AI 추천 뉴스 팝업 닫기 SK하이퍼, 국내에 463조 규모…초대형 AI 데이터센터 짓는다 입력 2026.10.23 17:41 수정 2026.10.23 17:41 지면 A12 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 라현진 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. 15GW 규모…2035년까지 구축 빅테크·투자자서 자금조달 구상 SK텔레콤의 인공지능(AI) 데이터센터 사업개발 전문회사 SK하이퍼가 국내에 3500억달러(약 463조원)를 들여 초대형 AI 데이터센터를 구축한다. 글로벌 빅테크와 투자자로부터 자금을 유치해 투자 부담을 나눈다는 구상이다. 23일 업계에 따르면 SK하이퍼는 2035년까지 국내에 총 15기가와트(GW) 규모의 데이터센터를 구축하기 위해 글로벌 빅테크 및 금융투자자와 자금 조달 협상을 진행하고 있다. 정석근 SK하이퍼 최고경영자(CEO)는 블룸버그와의 인터뷰에서 “1단계 5GW 구축에만 3500억달러가 필요하다”고 밝혔다. 3500억달러는 전체 15GW 중 첫 5GW 구축 단계에 필요한 투자금이다. SK하이퍼는 연말이나 내년 초 첫 외부 투자금을 확보하는 것을 목표로 하고 있다. 이후 3~4년에 걸쳐 추가 자금을 조달할 계획이다. 데이터센터 입주 기업과 외부 투자자가 전체 사업비를 분담하는 구조다. 정 CEO는 “다수의 전략적·재무적 투자자와 협의하고 있다”고 전했다. 다만 글로벌 시장에서 AI 투자 과열에 대한 우려가 커지는 점은 변수다. 천문학적인 데이터센터 투자금을 향후 AI 서비스 수요로 회수할 수 있을지에 대한 의문이 제기되고 있는 상황이다. SK하이퍼는 전체 투자 계획을 한꺼번에 확정하기보다 실제 고객 수요에 따라 단계적으로 사업을 추진할 계획이다. 그는 “시장 수요에 맞춰 위험을 적절히 관리해 나갈 것”이라고 설명했다. SK하이퍼는 울산 AI 데이터센터를 시작으로 영남권에 2GW 이상의 AI 데이터센터 클러스터를 조성하고 충청권과 서남권에도 기가와트급 데이터센터를 구축할 예정이다. 아시아와 중동 정부를 대상으로 컴퓨팅 인프라와 AI 모델을 통합 제공하는 사업도 검토하고 있다. 정 CEO는 초기 데이터센터가 완공되는 2029년에 앞서 이르면 내년부터 매출을 낼 수 있을 것으로 전망했다. SK그룹 계열사 간 시너지도 활용할 방침이다. 반도체와 에너지, 통신 분야의 기술을 결합해 상대적으로 높은 전력 비용을 상쇄하고 컴퓨팅 효율을 높이겠다는 것이다. SK텔레콤은 2030년까지 SK하이퍼에 7500억원을 투자하기로 했다. 라현진 기자 raraland@hankyung.com 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 ⓒ 한경닷컴, 무단전재 및 재배포 금지 한국경제 구독신청 한경 프리미엄9 구독신청 라현진 기자 안녕하세요. 한국경제신문 테크&사이언스부 라현진 기자입니다. Hackers appear to be struggling to exploit PHP flaws after global cybersecurity crisis
items.d: There were few, if any, reports of widespread damage by hackers exploiting PHP flaws, experts said, one day after officials warned of severe vulnerabilities.
items.fullText: Security Hackers appear to be struggling to exploit PHP flaws after global cybersecurity crisis The vulnerabilities are devastating in theory. But experts say they are also technically very difficult to hack. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 After researchers quietly found two devastating software vulnerabilities in August, they worked across borders and disciplines to develop patches that were released to the world Wednesday morning. Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 22, 2026, 6:07 PM EDT By Kevin Collier One day after governments around the world warned that newly publicized software vulnerabilities were so severe that websites should consider going offline until they could fix them, experts and insiders said there are few, if any, reports of widespread damage. That could still change, of course, and cybersecurity experts warn that the threat will remain for weeks, if not longer. Still, there were early signs Thursday that hackers were finding it difficult to capitalize on the vulnerabilities. “Across all our telemetry, and we are looking hard, we have only seen a couple of real exploitation attempts,” said Don Smith, vice president of threat research at the British software security firm Sophos. Experts agree that that was in part because of a behind-the-scenes, global effort that identified the flaw and quietly designed a fix to address it. The effort was aided, inadvertently, by the current limits of some widely available AI models, which did not appear to be very helpful at exploiting the vulnerabilities. And perhaps, they said, a little bit of luck. “My sense is that these [vulnerabilities] are harder to exploit than folks thought at first, so this could be a slow burn,” Smith said. The flaws were in PHP, a website programming language that is used in an estimated 69% of all websites. items.fullText: NVIDIA Transforms European Retail, From Digital Discovery to Physical Operations October 21, 2026 by Mavi Nafria 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! European retailers are using open models and physical intelligence across use cases — from a commerce platform cutting inference costs by 90% to to a fulfillment center where collaboration of different robotic fleets is simulated inside a digital twin. Frontier Results With Open Models Retail leaders and technology companies across Europe are using NVIDIA-accelerated open and frontier models to advance agentic commerce, digital product discovery and retail R&D. Shopify post-trains open models to reach frontier-level accuracy at a fraction of the cost. Its engineers use the NVIDIA Megatron Bridge library for faster fine-tuning and NVIDIA NeMo RL for reinforcement learning. Shopify has post-trained NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for the GraphQL subagent integrated into Sidekick, Shopify’s AI assistant for merchants. The subagent retrieves store data for several Sidekick features, including Sidekick Pulse, which researches a merchant’s store and recommends ways to improve it. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements On Shopify’s internal benchmark, the post-trained model surpasses a leading frontier model in accuracy while cutting serving costs by 90% and delivering responses 7x faster. Beyond Sidekick, NVIDIA CCluster vLLM inference optimization software helped Shopify achieve 4.5x faster performance and up to 12x lower inference cost across five additional use cases: catalog enrichment, merchant assistant, e-commerce shopping simulation, product taxonomy classification, and merchant and buyer recommendations. Zooplus , Europe’s leading online pet retailer, with Infosys and NVIDIA technologies rebuilt its product discovery stack for the agentic era. items.fullText: Google Cloud and NVIDIA Announce General Availability of NVIDIA Vera Rubin Infrastructure Google Cloud A5X instances, accelerated by NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems, support European innovators with next-generation agentic and reinforcement learning infrastructure. October 21, 2026 by Uttara Kumar 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! General availability of the instances is coming next month, with planned expansion of availability to Europe — bringing an integrated platform for training, inference and large-scale reinforcement learning to cloud customers. A5X instances bring together NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72, NVIDIA ConnectX-9 SuperNICs, Google Cloud Virgo Network and Google Cloud’s fourth-generation advanced liquid-cooling technology for demanding agentic inference and reinforcement learning workloads at scale. Google Cloud plans to scale its Vera Rubin-based infrastructure to as many as 960,000 Rubin GPUs across multiple sites. Ineffable Intelligence , a London-based technology company founded by AlphaGo creator David Silver, was the first customer to access A5X. Ineffable is using the platform to advance large-scale reinforcement learning and shape “superlearner” systems that learn continuously from experience. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Learning through interaction requires a continuous cycle of generating experience, evaluating outcomes and updating models, requiring infrastructure that can support the entire process at scale.
